infrastructure.name: CFO Cockpit Planning Mode — Scenario Modeling (Forward + Bounded-Backward)
infrastructure.notes: BACKLOG 2026-07-04 (CEO+PA inception, immediately after the Planning-Mode requirements definition pass). The interactive scenario capability INI-123 stubbed as '(coming soon)' and carved out as Phase D. Full requirements spec: knowledge/jasonos-vault/finance/planning-mode-requirements.md (Class C). CAPABILITY = define a scenario → evaluate → discard OR operationalize (append the decision queue + write a Cowork handoff brief; the app stages and writes materials, the President Agent drafts the plan in Cowork — the app never authors the plan). Two SEGREGATED modes sharing the engine: FORWARD ('what happens by date Y if I set levers X?', call-once) and BACKWARD, a BOUNDED solver — solve-for-date (forward + threshold detection, call-once) and solve-for-magnitude (fix target+date, ONE free action-lever, 1-D bisection, call-loop ~20-40 evals). Hard rail: exactly ONE free variable per query, ENFORCED not warned (a point answer, never a curve); a second variable is a separate exercise the app supports via CLONE. Non-monotonic RESULT CONTRACT (reached?, first-crossing, sustained-through-horizon?, revert date, not-reached) with absorbing-vs-oscillating metric classification + a target durability qualifier. THREE-TIER composable lever taxonomy (composable parts → primitives [the closed engine hypothetical-input contract] → composite templates, in scope v1) on an orthogonal action/assumption axis; posture is a composite macro, not a primitive; Planning Mode overlays hypotheticals on the model, never edits it. DEPENDS ON INI-124 delivering the foundation (engine-as-callable-service, session-scoped decrypt, scenario record type + write path, mini-side export) — the six requirement deltas are folded into INI-124 as of this filing. Sequenced AFTER INI-124.
